Usage: claude [options] [command]

Claude Code - starts an interactive session by default, use -p/--print for non-interactive output

Options:
  -p, --print                 Print response and exit (non-interactive mode)
  --output-format <format>    Output format for print mode (json, text)
  --permission-mode <mode>    Permission mode: default, plan, acceptEdits, bypassPermissions
  --resume <session_id>       Resume a previous session

Commands:
  chat          Start an interactive chat session
  config        Manage configuration
  mcp           Manage MCP server connections
  init          Create a CLAUDE.md file for this project

Slash commands available in this project:
  /compact             Compact the conversation
  /review              Run a code review
  /security-review     Run a security review
  /loop                Run a prompt on a recurring interval (goal/loop style automation)
  /workflow             Run a saved multi-agent workflow script

Skills:
  superpowers:brainstorming
  superpowers:test-driven-development
